method: Static analysis only - javap -c -p on the named 26.1.1 jars (client.jar for client classes, server-game.jar for server classes) for every vanilla method in scope, Rust source reads, prepared-data checks (items.json, block-tags.json, jar data files), and a full diff of every in-scope source file between the 26.1 and 26.1.1 trees in the worktree (389 files differ tree-wide; in-scope files individually diffed - see evidence/diff-*.txt). A sha1 byte-compare of 66 in-scope vanilla classes between the 26.1 and 26.1.1 jars found 0 diffs, so every jar-side 26.1 verification carries by identity - but each item was still re-verified fresh against the 26.1.1 jar and tree. NO drivers were run and NO oracle repairs were done: this batch is checks + triage only per the brief (no cargo builds, no driver runs). The 32 runnable drivers and 17 no-oracle drivers are recorded as not run, not as passes. Driver inventory: 74 drivers - 32 runnable-but-unrun, 25 blocked on 26 measured-failing oracles (Batch 0's measured table), 17 no-oracle; identical to 26.1. Oracle sets cross-checked against the 26.1.1 driver files; the only mismatch is interaction_input (also references the ParityData helper). Fixed in the 26.1.1 tree: B7-G04 (the peaceful gate was added), B7-G13/G14/G15 (masked - the code is still wrong but unreachable because no transform ever succeeds), B7-G16 (stays fixed, as in 26.1). Withdrawn for 26.1.1 (re-checked against 26.1.1's jar + tree): B7-G02 (26.1.1's BucketItem HAS the sneak check), B7-G05 (26.1.1 posts ENTITY_PLACE at the spawn position).
name: Items
out_of_scope_failures: Sign pick-block now carries sign_text_front/sign_text_back/waxed components (block_entity_item.rs, reverted from the 26.1 tree's deliberate drop) - Batch 4's scope (26.1 B4 covered the no-component form); vanilla 26.1.1 has no such components (SignBlockEntity saves only front_text/back_text/is_waxed). Enderman teleport reverted to the 26.3 tag form (mobs/enderman.rs now grounds on absent #entities_can_teleport_to, so endermen never teleport) - Batch 3's scope (B3-G14). Mob-head visibility reverted to the component form - recorded as B3-G33 (verified fresh here: vanilla getVisibilityPercent hardcodes five head/type pairs INCLUDING piglin_brute + piglin_head, correcting the 26.1 report's 'piglin brutes are not fooled' claim; LivingEntity is byte-identical between 26.1 and 26.1.1, so the 26.1 report was wrong on that point and on the 0..=10 clamp, which the method does not apply). Hoglin in the shared allowed_in_peaceful list (spawn_rules.rs:134, finalize.rs:897) - recorded as B3-G04, including the spawn-egg facet.
